subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT.------TR.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-27, second of two on book p139, paired with v2-p139-1. (C)C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) is crossed with TR (transformation): the question is what composite focused activism produces when crossed with transformation, in the same context where the spectacle-diversion is operative as the progressional platform. HI-P (high purpose), C-HM (composite humanity), and MT-INFO (multi-information) feed the upper part of the diagram. C-ACT (composite activism), WO-UNF (world unification), and OBS (observation) are mid-level constituting nodes. ECO-DY (economic dynamics) and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) feed the lower diagram. AF-POST (affinity postulation), AFI (affinity insight), IF-SPT (infra-spirituality), FUND-DY (fundamental dynamics), and APL-DT (application dictates) constitute the lower production layer. Structural argument: composite focused activism's path to transformation requires high-purpose and composite-humanity as foundational upstream commitments, with composite activism and world-unification as parallel intermediary structures. The diagram makes explicit Braxton's structural claim that activism transforms only when grounded simultaneously in cosmic purpose (high-purpose), humanistic commitment (composite-humanity), and infra-spiritual conviction (IF-SPT). Without all three, the activism remains at the spectacle layer.
